stories.title: Necessities join gifts in Black Friday shopping carts as AI and higher costs steer spending
stories.summary: "Usually, when you think of holiday shopping, it's premium handbags and jewelry and those types of items, but we're fast seeing shoppers also use this season to stock up on the essentials," analyst Vivek Pandya said.

stories.title: New York declares emergency as Thanksgiving storm threatens East Coast
stories.summary: Strong winds ripped the roof off a building in Maryland, as an extreme storm began to move up the East Coast on Thanksgiving morning.

stories.title: Bands drum up support so the show goes on for postponed Macy's Thanksgiving parade
stories.summary: Bands from across the country are drumming up support to stay in New York City through the weekend for the now-postponed 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.

stories.title: Young volunteers help feed thousands at Fayetteville Thanksgiving event
stories.summary: More than 100 volunteers helped serve a Thanksgiving meal to people in need, continuing a tradition that organizers say brings the community together.

stories.title: Triangle power outages persist after Thanksgiving storm downs trees, power lines
stories.summary: Thousands remain without power in the Triangle after strong winds and downed trees.

stories.title: Durham Rescue Mission Thanksgiving feast serves thousands despite rain
stories.summary: Hundreds of people gathered at the Durham Rescue Mission for its annual Thanksgiving feast and giveaway.

stories.title: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space. Scientists are skeptical
stories.summary: The Trump administration has given SpaceX the green light to deploy 1 million satellites that it said would create data centers in space.

stories.title: Egypt detains driver suspected of causing Cairo tanker crash that triggered inferno, killed 31
stories.summary: Egyptian authorities said they detained a speeding driver suspected of causing a fuel tanker to overturn on a major highway around Cairo.

stories.title: Rain exits Central NC, breezy conditions remain
stories.summary: Rain continues to push north but cloud cover remains this afternoon.

stories.title: Search underway for pregnant prisoner who escaped in corrections vehicle in New Mexico
stories.summary: A search was continuing in New Mexico on Thursday for a pregnant inmate who authorities allege escaped.

stories.title: Teaneck High School shooting: 19-year-old shot, killed during Turkey Bowl football game in New Jersey
stories.summary: A 19-year-old killed in shooting during Turkey Bowl football game between Hackensack and Teaneck on Wednesday night, officials said.

stories.title: ICE arrests man days after he wins $1 million lottery jackpot
stories.summary: He had just won a $1 million lottery jackpot. Days later, ICE agents arrested him in Boston.
